about: T4 step 2 (road map 26 Nov 2026): the round trip step 10 -> CAESAR II edits -> transfer -> step 10 -> transfer, run by tests/uxml-v2-step10-roundtrip.test.mjs. 'source' is the XML step 10 first runs on (under U3B_3DC, or this folder). The edits are made by prototypes/u2d-cii-source/tests/roundtrip_t4.py on step 10's first CII.

edits.values: wall thickness (element from end) and insulation (to end) at every point today's transfer refuses, one value per node id

cii2.why: lines: element 10-30 is a reducer; the edit set writes its wall (5) on the element only, and step 10 then writes the reducer's second wall from that wall. Nothing else in the file may differ.
